verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation or claims about GPU-accelerated rendering or rendering performance under heavy output; all docs focus on AI/agent features, privacy, and CLI tooling. Community reports even suggest UI glitches and 'horribly broken' behavior under load (warp-comm-10) and that the underlying terminal is just Alacritty (warp-comm-15), but nothing establishes or documents a GPU-rendering pipeline that stays fast under heavy output.
